summary: This document is the policy wording for a bundled motor two-wheeler insurance policy issued by Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited. It outlines the terms, conditions, coverage, exclusions, and obligations under two primary sections: Section I (Loss of or Damage to the Vehicle Insured) and Section II (Liability to Third Parties). The document includes details on depreciation rates for parts and painting, IDV calculation, exclusions, and conditions for claims. It also specifies the insurer's contact details, regulatory information, and policy reference numbers.
